text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky stops showing up for practice. 
Believing in her, her Trainer compiles 
past data to forge a weapon for her future 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer visits Seiun Sky with 
documents in hand. She tells the Trainer 
that she has reached her limit, and that 
it's time to call it quits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She truly wants to win. But she can no 
longer see a path to victory. Tears 
welling up in her eyes, Seiun Sky 
confesses her true feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Telling her that if it's an insurmountable 
wall, they'll smash through it together, 
the Trainer hands her the materials. She 
will definitely find a breakthrough. Right 
now, believing in her was the only choice.
